## Source discrepancies retained for adjudication

| ID | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `D01` | denominator_wording | Results says 54/73 positive runs were significant, while Figure 3 says 54% of all 100 runs were positive and significant. These are reconcilable only by preserving both the raw count (54) and both denominators. |
| `D02` | estimand_wording | Results describes a correlation between the Phi-r trajectory and replication state; the Figure 3 caption describes changes in Phi-r. Level and change are different estimands. |
| `D03` | prediction_endpoint_wording | Results describes predicting the remaining 75% of the full replication-state trajectory, while the Figure 5 title/caption calls the task prediction of initial appearance. |
| `D04` | unit_conflict | Table 1 prints time-to-first values with percent signs, but its note defines the outcome as a number of molecular steps. |
| `D05` | direction_conflict | Results says min-Phi-r significantly worsened all four outcomes, but Table 1 reports higher consistency for min (0.42) than control (0.38), where higher is defined as better. |
| `D06` | scope_conflict | Results says overall max-Phi-r probability did not significantly differ from control, whereas Discussion says maximizing yielded higher probability than original runs. The latter may refer only to the final generation, but does not say so there. |
| `D07` | spike_definition_gap | Text defines spikes as positive excursions more than three standard deviations above the overall mean and says most runs spike, but gives no run count or thresholding scope; plotted examples also contain prominent negative excursions. |
| `D08` | undecoded_formula | The supplied paper extraction contains two formula-not-decoded placeholders for the causal-emergence definition, preventing equation-level method linkage in S01. |
| `D09` | statistic_label_ambiguity | Figure 6C prints coefficients next to regression lines using rho-like notation, leaving unclear whether they are regression slopes or correlation coefficients. |
| `D10` | dispersion_undefined | Table 1 reports plus/minus quantities without defining whether they are standard deviations, standard errors, or confidence-interval half-widths. |
| `D11` | significance_scope_ambiguity | The p<0.001 Mann-Whitney statement for replicator versus drift steps does not state clearly whether it is a pooled test, a representative run, or a summary of runwise tests. |
| `D12` | spike_height_missing_statistic | Spike height is called nonsignificant without a reported coefficient or p-value. |
